summary: The creator performs a massive 350+ Heliolite dice pull on the Wishlist summon banner near the end of the season, aiming to get Kurvida and Serpentemis. The summon luck is generally poor, hitting pity multiple times and getting duplicate legendary pulls such as Oggok twice. Across 351 dice, seven legendaries are summoned including Oggok (x2), Tamar, Pardis, Sutha, Stanguem, and Ergander. The creator emphasizes the importance of Corrosion heroes for upcoming season metas and tips players to save up to 1,000 dice for Wishlist banners.

Prioritize getting high-impact DPS heroes to Inspiration 5 whenever possible for substantial stat and damage boosts.
